name: RealDays experiences
description: Experiences listed on RealDays, run by the local people who started them. Null means not confirmed.

experiences.name: Warbird aerobatic flight
experiences.summary: Loop, roll and spin in an ex-military Nanchang CJ-6A warbird, with just you and the pilot.
experiences.description: Adventure Flight Co flies high-G aerobatics in ex-military Nanchang CJ-6A warbirds from Moorabbin and Barwon Heads, a WWII-era fighter trainer that goes from 0 to 300km/h in under 5 seconds. It's just you and an experienced pilot, who starts gently and builds up the G force and difficulty as you go, talking you through every manoeuvre. Nervous flyer or adrenaline seeker, it can be mild or wild, it's up to you.
experiences.running_note: Flying warbird aerobatic flights since 2009, with over 6,000 flown
experiences.address_note: Flights leave from Barwon Heads Airport, Barwon Heads Road, Connewarre, or Moorabbin Airport in Melbourne. You choose when you book.
experiences.group_note: One passenger per flight, with the pilot
experiences.skill: No experience or special fitness needed. Maximum 130kg and 6'4" (193cm).
experiences.cancellation: Not given on the business's site. Ask Adventure Flight Co before you book.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on Adventure Flight Co's own site.

experiences.name: Make your own perfume in a Geelong atelier
experiences.summary: Blend your own fragrance from 70 ingredients with perfumer Aysha Hansen.
experiences.description: Aysha Hansen is an independent Australian perfumer, born in Geelong and raised in Torquay. In her two-hour workshop you sit at her bench, smell your way through 70 ingredients from around the world (natural extracts, aroma chemicals and classic accords) and learn how top, middle and base notes fit together. You leave with a 30ml or 50ml eau de toilette you made yourself. She keeps your formula on file, so you can order it again later, made up at eau de parfum strength, from $135 for 30ml. The workshop suits beginners as well as fragrance lovers, on your own or in a group of up to 8, and her site suggests it for birthdays, bridal parties, mother-and-daughter days and team building. Her atelier is at Boom Creative Spaces in Newtown.
experiences.full_address: Aysha Hansen Parfum Atelier, Boom Creative Spaces, 5 Rutland St, Newtown VIC 3220
experiences.group_note: Come on your own or bring a group of up to 8. Aysha's site suggests it for birthdays, bridal parties, mother-and-daughter days and team building.
experiences.cancellation: Give at least 48 hours' notice to move your workshop; the fee isn't refundable and no-shows can't be refunded.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on Aysha Hansen's own site.

experiences.name: Mediterranean Summer Cooking, Wednesdays
experiences.summary: Four weekly Mediterranean cooking classes in a small group, each ending with lunch at the table.
experiences.description: Mediterranean Summer Cooking with Elizabeth Peddey, in her kitchen in Elwood, Melbourne. It's an intermediate program, for cooks who already know their way around a kitchen and want to be inspired. Four weekly hands-on classes on Wednesdays from 11am to 2pm, 11 November to 2 December 2026, in groups of 4 to 6. Book the 4-week block, which comes with an apron to keep, or single classes. Each class starts with a glass of wine and snacks, and ends at the table eating what the group has cooked. You take home the recipes. Elizabeth has a Master's in Gastronomy from Le Cordon Bleu and the University of Adelaide. For ages 18 and over, as wine is served.

offers.label: Mediterranean Summer Cooking, single Wednesday class

experiences.private_bookings: Private classes are a separate booking. Ask Elizabeth.
experiences.duration_text: 3-hour classes, one a week for 4 weeks, or a single class
experiences.skill: Intermediate. For cooks who already know their way around a kitchen; not ideal for absolute beginners.
experiences.cancellation: Classes and courses are non-refundable but fully transferable. To transfer your place, email Elizabeth at elizabeth@elizabethpeddey.com.au.
experiences.booking_note: Book directly with Elizabeth by email or WhatsApp, from her website. She confirms your place and arranges payment.

experiences.name: Four-Legged Milking Stool
experiences.summary: Build a four-legged stool from scratch over a weekend, for complete beginners.
experiences.description: A two-day woodworking course for complete beginners in an off-grid workshop in the Indigo Valley. Guided by Andy Hooke, you build a four-legged stool from scratch using locally sourced and recycled timber. You learn safe use of woodworking machinery, hand tool techniques, timber selection and preparation, shaping and joinery, then sanding and finishing. All materials and timber, tuition, use of tools, and morning and afternoon tea are included, and you take the finished stool home. Courses run in a small group, with numbers limited so that everyone gets individual guidance. The workshop is off-grid, at Andy's home in the Indigo Valley, 30 minutes from Albury Wodonga, 15 minutes from Yackandandah and 25 minutes from Beechworth. Many people stay nearby and make a weekend of it. Indigo Woodworks asks for a 50% deposit on booking and the rest when the course finishes. Gift certificates are available.
experiences.days_and_times: Saturday and Sunday. Every 2026 date left on Indigo Woodworks' courses page showed as fully booked when we checked on 31 Oct 2026. New dates and cancellations go through Andy's own page and mailing list.
experiences.cancellation: Your deposit covers materials, so if you can't make it let Andy and Tess know as soon as possible. If they can cover your spot, they will refund your deposit in full.
experiences.booking_note: Book through Indigo Woodworks, with a 50% deposit on booking and the rest when the course finishes.

experiences.name: Three Legged Perch Stool
experiences.summary: Shape and turn a three-legged perch stool over three days, for people with some woodworking experience.
experiences.description: A three-day woodworking course in an off-grid workshop in the Indigo Valley, for people who have done the beginner course or have woodworking experience. Working with Andy Hooke, you make a three-legged perch stool and go further into shaping, turning, timber, tool use and furniture construction. All materials and timber, tuition, use of tools, and morning and afternoon tea are included, and you take the finished stool home. Courses run in a small group, with numbers limited so that everyone gets individual guidance. The workshop is off-grid, at Andy's home in the Indigo Valley, 30 minutes from Albury Wodonga, 15 minutes from Yackandandah and 25 minutes from Beechworth. experiences.cancellation: Your deposit covers materials, so if you can't make it let Andy and Tess know as soon as possible. If they can cover your spot, they will refund your deposit in full.

experiences.name: Sunday afternoon in a ceramics studio
experiences.summary: Make what you like in clay on a Sunday afternoon, with all materials and firings included.
experiences.description: A two-hour Sunday session at Peachy Keen Ceramics, a home pottery studio in Mount Eliza on the Mornington Peninsula, founded by Caitlin, a teacher and potter. There is no set project: bring your own idea or look through the studio's examples, and make what you like, such as a vase or a platter. No clay experience is needed, and people who have some get help with new techniques and harder projects. All materials and firings are included. You can decorate your pieces with underglaze, or the studio can finish them in its white speckle glaze. Pieces take about 4 weeks to dry and fire, and need to be collected from the studio within 2 months. People with accessibility needs can say so when booking. You can come on your own or bring a friend. The studio address is sent by email after you book.
experiences.address_note: A private home studio. The address comes by email once you book.
experiences.group_note: Small classes. Come on your own or bring a friend.
experiences.private_bookings: Yes. Private pottery events for hens parties, team building, Christmas parties, birthdays, and school and community groups, at the Mount Eliza studio or at your venue. Ask the studio for prices.
experiences.cancellation: Cancel 7 days or more before for a full refund. Between 48 hours and 7 days there's no refund, but you get a studio credit or one chance to reschedule. Under 48 hours there's no refund, credit or reschedule.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on Peachy Keen Ceramics' own site.

experiences.name: Carve your own ring, cast in sterling silver
experiences.summary: Design and carve a ring in jeweller's wax, then have it cast in sterling silver, in a two-hour workshop in Mount Eliza.
experiences.description: The Darling Objects lost wax ring workshop at Peachy Keen Ceramics, a home studio in Mount Eliza on the Mornington Peninsula. You learn to work with jeweller's wax, then design, carve and shape your own ring. No jewellery experience is needed, and you don't need to arrive with a design idea: they help you work it out. Once your ring is finished it is sent off for casting, and Holly, the studio jeweller, polishes it ready to wear. All wax, tools and workshop materials are included, with sterling silver casting (up to 10g of silver) in the $280 price. You can choose solid 9ct gold or bronze instead, with any extra metal cost charged by weight. The studio address is sent by email after you book.
experiences.address_note: A private home studio. The address comes by email once you book.
experiences.cancellation: Cancel 7 days or more before for a full refund. Between 48 hours and 7 days there's no refund, but you get a studio credit or one chance to reschedule. Under 48 hours there's no refund, credit or reschedule.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on Peachy Keen Ceramics' own site.

experiences.name: Cook a summer seafood feast on the Mornington Peninsula
experiences.summary: Prep and cook a Christmas seafood spread with a fishmonger and a cooking teacher, with matched wines and the recipes to take home.
experiences.description: A four-hour seafood class in Dromana, just before Christmas. A local fishmonger from Peninsula Fresh Seafood shows you how to prep fish and summer shellfish, with tips and tricks along the way. Then cooking teacher Tamara cooks the recipes with you, and you taste each one with matched wines. To finish, she shares her two favourite Christmas dessert recipes. You go home with a folder of every recipe, ready for your own Christmas table and summer gatherings. Classes are small, at most 12, and suit keen cooks and beginners alike.
experiences.cancellation: Peninsula Gourmet Cooking School handles changes and cancellations; ask them before you book.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on Peninsula Gourmet Cooking School's own site.

experiences.name: Pottery Wheel Taster Class
experiences.summary: Two hours on the pottery wheel in a small class, with 2 of your pieces glazed and fired.
experiences.description: A pottery wheel taster class at StudioMade, Darren McGinn's working studio in Newtown, Geelong. Two hours, no more than 6 people per tutor: a tour of the wheel house and kiln room, a lesson in wedging clay, then centring, pulling and throwing, including a breakfast cup with a handle. Glazing and firing of 2 finished pieces is included, ready to collect in about 2 to 4 weeks. $120 a person including GST. No experience needed; children over 8 are welcome with an adult who is also booked in.
experiences.group_note: No more than 6 people per tutor.
experiences.private_bookings: Private sessions for 2, parties, family and work groups. Ask StudioMade.
experiences.days_and_times: Saturdays 10am to 12pm: 21 and 28 November, 5 and 12 December 2026
experiences.what_to_bring: A long apron or a towel for your lap. Closed shoes are a must; short sleeves and trimmed nails work best.
experiences.cancellation: No refunds or make-up classes for a change of mind, illness or anything else unforeseen. If StudioMade cancels, for example when a class doesn't reach its minimum, you get a full refund or a move to another class.
experiences.booking_note: Book and pay on StudioMade's own website. Gift vouchers are sold there too.

experiences.name: Couple Leather Pencil Case Class
experiences.summary: Make matching leather pencil cases for two and stamp your names on them.
experiences.description: A leather class for two people, such as partners, friends or family, at Sui Workshop in Mulgrave. You cut, assemble and hand-stitch matching pencil cases in Italian leather, then stamp your names on them. You can add an animal charm for a higher price. The class is for beginners and you take what you make home. Suigeneris Atelier is a leather goods brand and craft studio with over 15 years of experience in leather crafting. All tools and materials are provided. Book at least 24 hours ahead on Sui Workshop's own booking page, and you get the studio address when you book.
experiences.running_note: Over 15 years of experience in leather crafting
experiences.address_note: You get the studio address when you book.
